notes: Riot announces errata as prose; printed cards and the gallery API keep the old text. scripts/build-cards.mjs applies these as exact-substring replacements (in the gallery's :rb_*: icon dialect) and fails if a find-string does not match exactly once per printing.

Source for all 2026-07-23 entries: https://playriftbound.com/en-us/news/announcements/vendetta-errata-updates (fetched 2026-09-02). Riot's [C]/[1]/[M] shorthand was translated to the icon tokens the gallery uses.
